text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahraini and Qatari transport ministers leave for Singapore to participate in "Asia Communications 97" conference to be held from June 9 to 14.
- Big investments needed to keep up with the growing population, an expert says.
- Al Hoty Analytical Services company wins a 600,000 dinar contract for preliminary work associated with a new port and industrial area in Hidd.
- Real estate worth seven million dinars were was traded in Bahrain last month.
- A Sri Lankan trade team to visit Bahrain at the end of June to seek investment opportunities.
